name: DocuGuard – AI TamperLens
tagline: Detect document tampering & AI-generated forgery for banking, KYC and claims.
description: An AI-powered forensics platform that inspects PDFs and images to flag tampering and AI-generated forgery. It combines document-native forensics, pixel-level checks, OCR, and optional multimodal LLM reasoning — running entirely on CPU with no GPU dependency, making it cost-efficient to deploy at scale.
roi: Cuts manual document review time for KYC and claims onboarding
Reduces fraud losses by catching tampered and synthetic documents early
CPU-only design avoids GPU infrastructure cost
Reusable across banking, insurance and lending workflows

name: FD Rates with Foundry
tagline: Enterprise Fixed-Deposit rate aggregator powered by Azure AI Foundry agents.
description: A production-grade aggregator that collects Fixed Deposit rates from Indian banks using Azure AI Foundry agents with custom function tools (fetch webpage, PDF and image). It supports parallel scraping, HTTP caching, robots.txt compliance and multiple deployment topologies from App Service to AKS — built for high availability and cost optimization.
roi: Replaces manual rate collection across dozens of bank sites
Always-current data for comparison and customer advisory
Multi-region HA with one-click Deploy to Azure
Caching and parallelism reduce compute and run cost

name: Agentic Email Processing
tagline: Hands-free email intake with agents for contract extraction & verification.
description: An event-driven, multi-agent system that ingests email via Logic Apps and orchestrates AI agents for contract data extraction, form verification and security checks. Infrastructure is provisioned as code with Bicep across Azure AI Foundry, Storage and Document Intelligence, with a Flask dashboard for visibility.
roi: Automates inbox-to-data intake with no manual handling
Reduces review effort for contracts and onboarding forms
Event-driven design scales with volume on demand
IaC makes the solution repeatable across environments

name: OCR Accuracy Lab
tagline: Side-by-side OCR benchmark: Azure Document Intelligence vs GPT models.
description: An interactive benchmarking app that runs the same document through Azure Document Intelligence and multiple GPT models, then scores results with an LLM-as-judge. It surfaces accuracy metrics and visual diffs so teams can make a transparent, data-driven choice of OCR provider.
roi: Removes guesswork from OCR vendor and model selection
Quantifies accuracy before committing to production
Builds customer trust with transparent, judged comparisons
Reusable harness for any new document type

name: VoiceRAG
tagline: Low-latency inbound voice bot grounded with Azure AI Search RAG.
description: A real-time inbound voice bot that compares two processing paths — Azure Voice Live versus a composed Speech SDK pipeline — while grounding answers with Retrieval Augmented Generation over Azure AI Search. Redis semantic caching and a live latency dashboard demonstrate enterprise-grade responsiveness.
roi: Delivers low-latency, natural voice interactions
Grounded answers reduce hallucination and support cost
Semantic caching cuts repeated model calls and spend
Dual-path design de-risks the voice architecture choice

name: PII Shield
tagline: Privacy guardrail that detects & anonymizes PII between your apps and LLMs.
description: A drop-in privacy layer that sits between applications and LLMs, detecting and anonymizing personally identifiable information before prompts ever reach the model. It pairs Microsoft Presidio with an ONNX-optimized BERT NER model for fast, accurate entity recognition, then de-identifies (and can re-identify) sensitive data so teams can adopt generative AI without leaking PII.
roi: Prevents PII leakage into third-party LLM prompts
Supports compliance with data-protection and privacy rules
ONNX-optimized NER keeps latency and cost low on CPU
Reusable guardrail across any app-to-LLM integration

name: Cheque Verification Prototype
tagline: AI cheque verification: OCR field extraction plus signature match with a live call trace.
description: A .NET Blazor prototype that verifies bank cheques end to end. Azure Document Intelligence reads the cheque, GPT-4o vision structures the fields and compares the drawn signature against the account's registered specimen, and deterministic C# rules apply the funds and match thresholds for a final verdict. A per-call trace panel surfaces every OCR and LLM step with token counts and latency.
roi: Automates cheque field capture and signature checks
Catches forged signatures and mismatched account details early
Keyless managed-identity design avoids stored secrets
Parallel LLM calls keep verification fast and low cost

name: Cheque Verification – Foundry Agents
tagline: The same cheque check, re-imagined as an autonomous Azure AI Foundry agent.
description: The agentic edition of the cheque prototype. A GPT-4o agent on Azure AI Foundry is handed the cheque image plus lookup_account and check_funds function tools, then orchestrates the account lookup, funds check and signature comparison on its own — while the final 85/60 verdict stays deterministic in C#. It shows the same problem solved with tool-calling agents versus a hand-coded pipeline.
roi: Shows an autonomous agent orchestrating a real workflow
Keeps critical verdict logic deterministic and auditable
Reuses one backend for both direct-SDK and agent paths
Data-resident gpt-4o keeps processing in-region

name: Customer Mail Agent
tagline: Human-in-the-loop email agent that drafts grounded replies and logs every step.
description: An agentic email assistant that reads inbound customer mail, detects intent and retrieves grounded answers from a closed FAQ corpus using an Azure AI Foundry IQ knowledge source over Blob Storage. It drafts a reply for a human to approve, edit or regenerate before sending, and records every step — received, intent, retrieval, draft, revision, approval and send — across dedicated storage containers for a full audit trail.
roi: Automates first-draft replies to common customer queries
Keeps a human in control of every outgoing message
Grounded RAG answers cut hallucination and rework
Per-mail audit trail supports compliance and QA reviews

name: MAI-Transcribe-2
tagline: Fast, multilingual speech-to-text from Microsoft AI — batch diarization plus three real-time pipelines.
description: A capability demo for MAI-Transcribe-2, Microsoft AI's fast multilingual speech model. A Batch tab handles one-shot upload or record with full MAI diarization and click-to-seek playback, while a Real time tab offers three live pipelines: MAI near-real-time (~8-second windows for highest accuracy and Hinglish), Standard Azure Speech SDK (instant interim words for live captions), and Hybrid (live captions now, replaced by a cleaner MAI pass on stop). The browser streams 16 kHz PCM16 audio over a WebSocket while the server holds keyless Entra ID credentials, so no token ever reaches the client.
roi: Accurate multilingual transcription, including Hinglish code-switching
Three pipelines trade latency versus accuracy for any scenario
Keyless Entra ID keeps speech credentials off the browser
Reusable for live captions, dictation and batch diarization

name: AOAI Prompt Port
tagline: Migrate & optimize Azure OpenAI prompts across GPT deployments safely.
description: A Gradio UI that migrates and optimizes Azure OpenAI prompts between GPT deployments. It streams progress and returns a ship / no-ship decision with scoring and diffs, so teams can move to newer models with confidence and an audit trail of quality.
roi: De-risks model upgrades with automated evaluation
Ship / no-ship scoring prevents quality regressions
Speeds prompt migration that is otherwise manual
Reusable across any Azure OpenAI deployment pair
